query: Equinix Q3 2026 revenue total and segment results recent filing
normalized: 2026 equinix filing q3 results revenue segment total

output.content:
Equinix has not yet filed or reported **Q3 2026** as of October 17, 2026: its investor-relations filing page identifies the latest quarterly filing as the **Q2 2026 Form 10-Q**, filed July 29, 2026, while Q3 earnings are scheduled for October 28, 2026. [[1, 2]] 

In the latest reported quarter, **Q2 2026 (three months ended June 30, 2026)**, Equinix generated **$2.625 billion of total revenue**, up **16% year over year** from **$2.256 billion**. [[3, 4]]

| Q2 2026 segment result | Revenue ($m) | Recurring revenue ($m) | Non-recurring revenue ($m) | Segment adjusted EBITDA ($m) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Americas | 1,251 | 1,067 | 184 | 641 |
| EMEA | 845 | 806 | 39 | 456 |
| Asia-Pacific | 529 | 504 | 25 | 299 |
| **Total** | **2,625** | **2,377** | **248** | **1,396** |

The figures above are from Equinix’s Q2 2026 Form 10-Q, which defines the company’s three reportable geographic segments as Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific and reports revenue and adjusted EBITDA by segment. [[4]] 

Americas was the largest and fastest-growing segment, with revenue up **$247 million, or 25% year over year**, to $1.251 billion; EMEA revenue rose **$78 million, or 10%**, to $845 million; and Asia-Pacific revenue rose **$44 million, or 9%**, to $529 million. [[4]] 

For context only, Equinix’s Q2 release guided to **Q3 2026 revenue of $2.525 billion to $2.575 billion**, rather than reporting a Q3 actual result. [[3]]
